SlideMate 0.7.1 keeps Claude's model list up to date by itself and fixes a stuck Claude sign-in.

### New
- **Claude's newest models appear by themselves.** The model menu now follows Claude Code's own list, so a new Claude model shows up without waiting for a SlideMate update. Fable now runs Fable 5.2, and Haiku runs Haiku 5.5.

### Fixes
- **Closed the sign-in tab?** Claude's sign-in no longer spins forever. Choose **Open the sign-in page again** or **Start over**, on the welcome screen or in Settings.
- A sign-in code you're typing in Settings no longer disappears halfway through.
